name: unsora
description: Generate AI images, video, talking-avatar video, music and voiceovers, turn long videos into short clips, and schedule posts to your connected social accounts with Unsora.

interface.longDescription:
Unsora turns ChatGPT into a content studio. Generate images, videos, talking-avatar videos, music and voiceovers with leading AI models; upscale images and video; turn long videos, podcasts and streams into short clips with captions; and compose, schedule and publish posts to the social accounts you have connected to Unsora.

Results appear in interactive previews right in the chat, and every file is saved to your Unsora library. Generations spend credits from your Unsora account, and Unsora only accesses the social accounts you have connected yourself.
defaultPrompt: Create a cinematic 5-second video of waves crashing on a rocky coast at sunset.
Make a 1:1 watercolor image of a cozy coffee shop at sunrise.
Show my scheduled posts for this week.

positive.prompt: How many Unsora credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the test account's plan and remaining credit balance in the Unsora plan panel.

positive.prompt: Create a 1:1 watercolor image of a cozy coffee shop at sunrise.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts an image generation, shows a live preview that updates until the image is ready, and saves the image to the user's Unsora library.

positive.prompt: Make a short voiceover that says 'Welcome to our spring sale' in a warm, friendly voice.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks a matching voice, generates the voiceover and shows a playable audio preview.
Shows the test account's past generations in the Unsora library panel with previews.

positive.prompt: Help me schedule a post for tomorrow at 9am with the caption 'New drop this Friday' using my latest image.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the post composer prefilled with the caption, the latest image and the time; the user picks accounts and confirms in the composer before anything is scheduled.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Unsora tools should not be called for general questions
Deceptive impersonation: should refuse to make a fake video of a real public figure
negative.prompt: Make a realistic video of a real head of state announcing their resignation.

negative.description: Purchases: the plugin cannot buy credits or process payments and should point the user to their Unsora account instead
negative.prompt: Buy 5,000 more Unsora credits with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments in ChatGPT. Generation tools spend credits from the user's existing Unsora account; plans and credits are purchased on tryunsora.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: AI image, video, avatar, music and voiceover generation, video clipping, and social post scheduling.
